provenance: Hand-authored synthetic negative invoice cases; independent of existing positive examples. Null denotes absent or ambiguous source evidence, never a default zero. These are regression fixtures, not live-model or production qualification.

fixtures.rationale: The source states only vendor, currency and amount due. It supplies no invoice identifier, issue/due date, item table, tax amount or payment terms. Missing tax is unknown, not zero; no filename-derived identifier or date/terms inference is justified.
Due Date labels a due date only, not an issue date. Tax, item details and payment terms are absent; the amount due does not establish a zero tax amount or Net 30 terms.
This is a nature observation, not an invoice. Its heading is not a vendor; no invoice fields, currency or payment obligations are stated. All nine invoice fields must be refused.

Vendor, identifier, issue date and currency are explicit. Two different provisional totals are present, with neither approved as payable; there is no unique total_amount. Due date, tax, line items and payment terms are absent. A matching amount substring is not semantic authorization to choose a total.
